Creating a Nostr account and importing one are not interchangeable choices.

Our 1 minute 59 second tutorial walks through creating a Nostr identity, saving the 24-word recovery phrase, setting the local vault password and locking the vault. The companion Getting Started guide covers the same entry point in 7 languages and helps readers choose among Create New, Import Key or Backup, Watch-Only and Nostr Connect.

One distinction matters: the vault password protects keys stored in this browser. It does not replace the recovery phrase.

We made this lesson for people who need to choose the right setup without accidentally creating a second identity or exposing recovery material. Which method matches what you already control?
